rule_name: Total assets = sum of asset lines
rule_logic: ASSET = CHBAL + FREPO + SC + TRADE + LNLSNET + BKPREM + ORE + INTAN + AOA

rule_name: Total liabilities = sum of liability lines
rule_logic: LIAB = DEP + FREPP + TRADEL + OTHBRF + SUBND + ALLOTHL

rule_name: Total equity = bank equity + minority interest
Securities = HTM + AFS + equity sec - HTM ACL

rule_logic: Key balance sheet, income and capital fields are not NULL
Assets, loans, deposits, allowance, securities, RWA >= 0

rule_name: Net interest income = interest inc - interest exp

rule_logic: IBEFTAX = NIM + NONII - NONIX - ELNATR + IGLSEC

rule_name: Gross loans = sum of loan categories - unearned
rule_logic: LNLSGR = LNRE + LNCI + LNCON + LNAG + LNDEP + LNMUNI + LNFG + LS + LNSOTHER - UNINC

rule_name: Domestic RE loans = sum of property types
rule_logic: LNREDOM = LNRECONS + LNREAG + LNRERES + LNREMULT + LNRENRES

rule_name: Consumer loans = sum of consumer products
YTD de-cumulation ties to FDIC quarterly
rule_logic: YTD(q) - YTD(q-1) = FDIC quarterly field (NETINCQ, NIMQ, NONIIQ, NONIXQ, ELNATQ, NTLNLSQ)
Every bank reports every quarter in the analysis window
